# 環境 windows × 勾選 wakatime

## 選單
zsh              zsh、自動建議／跳目錄／語法上色外掛,並改成預設 shell（裝不了：Windows 的 shell 是 PowerShell，補全、語法上色內建，跳目錄的 zoxide 每台 Windows 都裝）
starship         提示列：顯示目錄、git 狀態、時間，跨 shell 共用一份設定 [mise]
eza              彩色、帶圖示的 ls(ll、la、lt 用它) [mise]
fzf              模糊搜尋:Ctrl-R 找歷史、Ctrl-T 找檔案 [mise]
bat              有語法上色的 cat [mise]
ripgrep          rg:比 grep 快的全文搜尋 [mise]
vim              終端機文字編輯器 [mise]
fastfetch        終端機印出系統資訊 [mise]
btop             終端機看 CPU、記憶體、行程（裝不了：btop 的 release 只有 Linux 版，改勾 bottom）
bottom           btm:跨 OS 的終端機資源監控(CPU、記憶體、行程),Windows 也能用 [mise]
earlyoom         記憶體快滿先砍最肥的程序；ssh、tailscale、ssm-agent 保有記憶體和 CPU（裝不了：earlyoom 與記憶體、CPU 的保護都靠 Linux 的 systemd，只裝在 Linux）
gh               GitHub CLI(官方 apt 源),裝完 gh auth login [mise]
code-server      瀏覽器開的 VS Code（裝不了：code-server 官方不出 Windows 版，到 WSL 裝）
tailscale        私人 VPN,連自己的機器 [winget]
cloudflared      Cloudflare Tunnel:把服務開給 tailnet 外的人 [mise]
herdr            終端機多工,同時開多個 coding agent [mise]
ttyd             把終端機開成網頁,share-shell 用 [mise]
wakatime         wakatime-cli:把寫程式的時間送到 WakaTime(有勾的 agent 與 code-server 一併裝 plugin;會一併裝 Node) [script]
claude           Claude Code CLI [official]
codex            Codex CLI [official]
opencode         OpenCode CLI(會一併裝 Node) [mise]
ffmpeg           影音轉檔、抽音軌與影格 [mise]
snapserver       Snapcast 朗讀串流服務:agent 的回覆唸到個人電腦,voice-out on、off 開關(會一併裝 ffmpeg、uv)（裝不了：snapserver 沒有 Windows 版，朗讀服務放跑 agent 的 Linux 主機）
snapclient       Snapcast 的 CLI 播放端:在個人電腦收聽已配置主機的朗讀串流 [mise]
node             Node LTS（Linux、macOS 用 nvm 裝，Termux 用 pkg，Windows 用 mise；勾了 playwright-cli、opencode、wakatime 也會自動裝） [mise]
codegraph        程式碼索引給 agent 查(mise 裝官方 release) [mise]
headless-chrome  沒有畫面的 Chrome,給 agent 開網頁 [winget]
playwright-cli   agent 操作瀏覽器(用 headless-chrome,會一併裝 Node) [mise]
agent-config     skillshare:統一管理 agent 的 skills、MCP、全域規則(agent-config repo) [official]

## init 存下的設定
[data]
    wakatimeApiKey = ""
    machineUse = "custom"
    tools = ["wakatime"]
    toolsSchema = 3

    # 個人 Codex 使用的非秘密模型資料。
    [data.aiPersonal]
    codexModel = ""

[interpreters.ps1]
    command = "powershell"
    args = ["-NoLogo", "-NoProfile", "-ExecutionPolicy", "Bypass", "-File"]

wakatime node

## mise 清單
# chezmoi 照選裝工具的勾選產生(home/dot_config/mise/conf.d/dotfiles.toml.tmpl),別直接改,下次 apply 會蓋掉。
# 自己要加的工具用 `mise use -g <工具>`,寫在 ~/.config/mise/config.toml,不會跟這份打架。
# 誰走 mise 見 home/.chezmoidata/tool-table.yaml;run_onchange_after_install-mise 在這份變了之後跑 mise install。
[tools]
"zoxide" = "latest"
"node" = "lts"

## 渲染成空的腳本
.chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_after_install-agent-config.ps1.tmpl
.chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_after_install-official.ps1.tmpl
.chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_after_sync-skillshare.ps1.tmpl
.chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_after_zz-env-skipped.ps1.tmpl

## 會跑的腳本
.chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_after_install-mise.ps1.tmpl
.chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_after_install-wakatime.ps1.tmpl
.chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_before_install-packages-windows.ps1.tmpl

### .chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_after_install-mise.ps1.tmpl
# mise list (~/.config/mise/conf.d/dotfiles.toml):
#   "zoxide" = "latest"
#   "node" = "lts"
$env:PSModulePath = (($env:PSModulePath -split ';') | Where-Object { $_ -notmatch '\\PowerShell\\|\\Microsoft\.PowerShell_' }) -join ';'
function T([string]$b64) { [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([Convert]::FromBase64String($b64)) }

$env:Path = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path', 'Machine') + ';' + [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path', 'User')

if (-not (Get-Command mise -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
    Write-Host (T '5om+5LiN5YiwIG1pc2UsQ0xJIOW3peWFt+aykuijneOAguWFiCB3aW5nZXQgaW5zdGFsbCAtLWlkIGpkeC5taXNlIC0tZXhhY3Qs6ZaL5paw55qEIFBvd2VyU2hlbGwg5YaNIGNoZXptb2kgYXBwbHk=')
    exit 0
}

mise install
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
    Write-Host (T 'bWlzZSBpbnN0YWxsIOacieW3peWFt+aykuijneWlvSzkuYvlvozoh6rlt7Hot5E6bWlzZSBpbnN0YWxs')
}
exit 0

### .chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_after_install-wakatime.ps1.tmpl
$env:PSModulePath = (($env:PSModulePath -split ';') | Where-Object { $_ -notmatch '\\PowerShell\\|\\Microsoft\.PowerShell_' }) -join ';'
function T([string]$b64) { [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([Convert]::FromBase64String($b64)) }

$dir = Join-Path $HOME '.wakatime'
$bin = Join-Path $dir 'wakatime-cli-windows-amd64.exe'
if (Test-Path $bin) {
    Write-Host (T 'd2FrYXRpbWUtY2xpIOW3suWuieijnSzot7PpgY4=')
} else {
    $url = 'https://github.com/wakatime/wakatime-cli/releases/latest/download/wakatime-cli-windows-amd64.zip'
    $tmp = Join-Path ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) ([IO.Path]::GetRandomFileName())
    try {
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $tmp | Out-Null
        [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol -bor [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12
        Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile (Join-Path $tmp 'wakatime.zip') -UseBasicParsing -ErrorAction Stop
        Expand-Archive -Path (Join-Path $tmp 'wakatime.zip') -DestinationPath $tmp -Force -ErrorAction Stop
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $dir | Out-Null
        Copy-Item -Path (Join-Path $tmp 'wakatime-cli-windows-amd64.exe') -Destination $bin -ErrorAction Stop
    } catch {
        Write-Host $_
        Write-Host ((T 'd2FrYXRpbWUtY2xpIOaykuijneWlvSzkuYvlvozoh6rlt7HkuIvovIkgezB9IOino+mWi+WIsCB7MX0=') -f $url, $dir)
    } finally {
        Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $tmp -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    }
}
$alias = Join-Path $dir 'wakatime-cli.exe'
if ((Test-Path $bin) -and -not (Test-Path $alias)) {
    Copy-Item -Path $bin -Destination $alias -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}

$env:Path = $env:Path + ';' + [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path', 'Machine') + ';' + [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path', 'User')
function Find-Agent([string]$name, [string]$official) {
    $c = Get-Command $name -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ($c) { return $c.Source }
    return $official
}
function Get-PluginList([string]$exe) {
    try { return (& $exe plugin list --json | Out-String | ConvertFrom-Json) } catch { return $null }
}
exit 0

### .chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_before_install-packages-windows.ps1.tmpl
$env:PSModulePath = (($env:PSModulePath -split ';') | Where-Object { $_ -notmatch '\\PowerShell\\|\\Microsoft\.PowerShell_' }) -join ';'
function T([string]$b64) { [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([Convert]::FromBase64String($b64)) }

$ids = @(
    'jdx.mise',
    'Microsoft.PowerShell',
    'Microsoft.WindowsTerminal',
    'Git.Git'
)

if (-not (Get-Command winget -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
    Write-Host ((T '5om+5LiN5YiwIHdpbmdldCzmspLoo506ezB944CC5b6eIE1pY3Jvc29mdCBTdG9yZSDoo53jgIzmh4nnlKjnqIvlvI/lronoo53nqIvlvI/jgI0oQXBwIEluc3RhbGxlcinlvozlho0gY2hlem1vaSBhcHBseQ==') -f ($ids -join ', '))
    exit 0
}

foreach ($id in $ids) {
    winget list --id $id --exact --accept-source-agreements *> $null
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { continue }
    winget install --id $id --exact --source winget --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements --disable-interactivity
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        Write-Host ((T 'd2luZ2V0IOaykuijneWlvSB7MH0s5LmL5b6M6Ieq5bex6LeROndpbmdldCBpbnN0YWxsIC0taWQgezB9IC0tZXhhY3Q=') -f $id)
    }
}
exit 0
